description: This file defines a custom SwiftUI view modifier named 'StatusGlassCardModifier' for styling views with a glass-like appearance, and extends the 'View' protocol to include a convenience method 'statusGlassCard' that applies this modifier. It primarily pertains to UI styling for the Status section in an iOS app.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that applies a glass-like styled background with rounded corners, border, and shadow to a view, with customizable padding and brightness.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view layout and styling for the modifier, including padding, background with rounded rectangle, overlay stroke, and shadow.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: A view extension method that applies the 'StatusGlassCardModifier' with specified parameters.
